findings.summary: Candidate (ESP32 3-class) retrained on the RK45-integrated dataset (R3/R4, after S-16/S-18), same recipe as the promoted run. Not promoted; the registry is unchanged.
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (speed x severity x noise x plant-drift grid, DC plant integrated with RK45); no real-machine validation exists.
3 classes (inner_race, normal, outer_race): a ball or cage fault is assigned to one of the 3 known classes, probably with high confidence; no OOD method catches it (AI-N13).
